observed_failure: The package automation failed to observe Confirm tool decision after Allow once. Its final UI Automation dump showed that control and the confirmation prompt, while the request remained pending.
cause: Find-Button searched descendants of the UI Automation window reference captured before the modal confirmation appeared.
change: Find-Button now enumerates current top-level UI Automation windows owned by the packaged process and searches each for the exact button.
acceptance_credit: none; require the exact Windows release package to pass refresh, allow, deny, receipt, and mock-effect assertions
